en.title: AI Financial Controller
en.text: A financial decision-support system for Kenyan SMEs, exploring deterministic financial health analysis, risk findings, anomaly detection, reporting, and a separate AI explanation layer. Development.

en.title: Road Condition AI
en.text: Computer-vision research around the RDD2022 dataset: imagery exploration, XML annotation processing, preprocessing, and potential mobile application integration. Ongoing.

en.title: Construction Fleet Management
en.text: A web-first concept for construction-material delivery with driver and dispatcher workflows, live location updates, fleet status, REST APIs, and database-backed operations. In design and development.

en.title: Scholarship Management System
en.text: A software-engineering project covering requirements analysis, UML, system architecture, layered application design, class and activity diagrams, system sequences, and ERD/database design.
